''See also: [[Ilana Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Ilana is a twenty-year-[[old woman]] from [[Myria]] who has spent months monitoring [[Alin]]. She is the sister of [[Simon]] and possesses a humorous, sarcastic personality, though she has experienced significant tragedy, including the death of her fiancé during a raid by [[Damascan soldiers]]. Originally accustomed to farm life and wearing earth-toned clothing, she later adopts more colorful fashions. Driven by a sense of responsibility toward her family and her brother, she travels through a Gate to follow him. During her journey, she encounters various entities, including Incarnation{{!}}the Incarnation, which leaves her severely injured but alive. Despite her struggles, she demonstrates combat capability by using a golden wooden bow and specialized arrows to strike a golem.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|As a companion and member of [[Alin]]'s party, Ilana traveled alongside him during his journey. Her safety was jeopardized when the [[Naraka Incarnation]] spilled her to the ground. Following this incident, [[Alin]] was forced to search for her before ultimately carrying her away.}}
